events.verdict: Leonard (LAC) gathers the pass and establishes his left foot as his pivot foot, which he maintains.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) reaches in and makes contact to Zubac's (LAC) wrist, causing him to lose control of the ball during his shooting motion.
Jones Jr. (LAC) extends an arm into Caruso (OKC) and makes illegal contact to his foot, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Hartenstein (OKC) moves forward into Jones Jr.'s (LAC) arm, causing him to lose control of the pass.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Zubac (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and OKC is given possession when play resumes.
Caruso (OKC) establishes himself in a screening position in Jones Jr.'s (LAC) path and the two players briefly engage and disengage.
Zubac (LAC) jumps to contest Hartenstein's (OKC) layup attempt and absorbs the contact initiated by Hartenstein.
Dort (OKC) legally contests Powell's (LAC) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Caruso (OKC) legally contests Leonard's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Jones Jr. (LAC) commits a take foul on Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).
Caruso (OKC) commits a take foul on Leonard (LAC).
